coordinates.object_orientation: Head-Y, tail+Y, dorsal+Z. Standard cameras plus purposeful ventral -Z.

concept.reason: Named specimen-backed dorsal/ventral reconstructions and explicit primary anatomical description suffice; no additional concepts.

extra_views.name: ventral
extra_views.reason: Verify independent endopod/exopod insertion, seven prosomal pairs and six gill pairs; not visible from normal top views.

scope: Entire Silurian animal anchored to serial-ground holotype OUMNH C.29640; no fossil slab or borrowed published mesh.

scale.note: 23.2mm and 9.2mm directly published same specimen. Other lengths are conservative modeling partitions estimated from same-specimen images; adjust to total, not independent measurements. Vaulted height inferred ~4mm; no foreign specimen scale.

anatomy: Semioval smooth vaulted shield; eyes not evidenced. Eleven free rear tergites: reduced concealed first, eight preabdominal and three postabdominal segments overall; tapering telson with two short terminal points.

Seven prosomal appendage pairs: elongated flexible chelicerae with tiny terminal chela; limbs2-5 each have separately inserting inner and outer rami; limb6 inner ramus only, nonchelate terminal; limb7 small spine-fringed flap.
Inner rami2-5 six podomeres plus terminal claw; outer rami shorter, five podomeres with terminal spine brushes. Six paired lamellate gill groups under preabdomen; attachment uncertain.
restoration_boundaries: Images are serial-grinding digital fossil reconstructions, not unprocessed photographs or artistic concept evidence. Distinct color segmentation in atlas is not biological coloration.
No copying research meshes/STL; construct original low-poly geometry from cited morphology. No new eyes, giant genal horns, fused modern horseshoe rear shield or scorpion sting.
Restore neutral symmetric stance instead of preserving taphonomic crossed/asymmetric limbs; exact minor joint angles, lamella count simplification, thickness and muted color are artistic choices.
Atlas figure3 A/B only match holotype; C/D/E other animals excluded.
quality_gates: Confirm 11 unfused tergites, not11 gill groups or fused thoracetron.
Confirm outer rami originate on body independently, never on inner legs. Four biramous pairs, not all seven pairs doubled.
Chelicerae are antenniform but not additional antennae; seventh pair tiny flap, sixth nonchelate.
Do not add observationally unsupported eyes or copy rainbow segmentation colors.
source_profile: palette-only, unrigged, static, original semantic parts retained; temporary material batches for export
